name: Real3D-AD: Point Cloud Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: High-precision 3D point cloud anomaly detection dataset comprising 1,254 full 360-degree point cloud scans across 12 object categories acquired via an industrial optical 3D scanner with high resolution (0.0010mm–0.0015mm). Developed by M-3LAB, it addresses 3D industrial defect inspection with pixel-accurate anomaly localization on complex geometries under realistic manufacturing scenarios.
